environment: Isolated production port 3001, temporary SQLite, fictional posts/replies; no user data edits or provider calls
checks: Like saves and survives refresh; Dislike replaces Like; second click cancels
Comment focuses inline editor; whitespace blocked; posting appears beneath its parent and clears draft without navigation
Replies and separate reply votes persist after refresh without duplicating the post
Community sidebar shows real counts, supports votes and opens the correct comment form
Rejected or stale parent preserves the draft and creates no reply
A hidden post deep link reveals no parent body, replies or reply composer
Reaction controls, reply list and editor fit 1440/1024/768/390/320px
